_about: Which local model each local-model job uses (AGENTS.md Rule 0). model null = today's model, from where that job always read it ("today" says where). To switch a job, put an installed Ollama model name in its model field: `python -m bench pick` proposes one from the latest bench results, but nothing here changes on its own. Order of precedence for one call: override_env (set only by `python -m bench run`, for the model it is measuring), then the job's own env override where it has one (DENISSE_MODEL for the chat entry), then model here, then today's.

don_extract.what: Don reads a lecture into outcomes, methods, examples, checks, topics (tutor/model.py extract_lecture)

don_cards.what: Don writes the local kinds of flashcard from a note (tutor/cards.py generate)

don_card_check.what: Don checks written cards against their note (tutor/cards.py check)

don_teach.what: Don's local lesson on one topic (tutor/teach.py)

denisse_brain.what: Denisse's replies and tool choice (brain.py; scored by eval/run_eval.py)

atrium_autopilot.what: Atrium's autopilot classifier: is a candidate actionable, repo-only, a bug fix (atrium/autopilot.py)
